spot.html_text: Are mass and energy the same property of physical systems and is that what is meant by asserting that they are “equivalent”? Is mass “converted” into energy in some physical interactions, and if so, what is the relevant sense of “conversion”? Does ⟦M⟧ have any ontological consequences, and if so, what are they?
